best_idea: Count accepted lines per session in a sliding one-second log before anything is relayed, reject the excess with a warning, and never let rejected lines count against the budget.
decision_why: Frankendom needs a server-side intake budget so a chat flood cannot flood the engine; the donor shape fits, but its window-edge burst, double count on retry, zero-division and wall-clock defects must be fixed, and fight inputs must not share the chat budget.
acceptance: A server test sends 80 chat lines in one second (all relay), an 81st in the same second returns too-fast, 80 lines at 999 ms and 80 at 1001 ms do not all relay, and a rate of 0 relays everything without throwing.
